examples: Spin up a folder for a quick prototype without leaving the app.
Find the project you worked on last week, sorted by last used.
how_to: Choose New Project, then start empty (a fresh folder) or open an existing folder.
Pick a provider, name it, then pick or type the folder it should live in - the full path is shown before anything is created, and that folder is used exactly as chosen, nothing appended to it.
Browse projects from the PROJECTS card and start a session in one.
On a paired computer, browse lists that computer's folders; an older carnivore there means you type the folder.
name: Create and browse projects
summary: create a new project folder and browse your projects from the home screen.
where: Home screen, the PROJECTS card; View all for the full list.
